reason: The text demonstrates Yahweh's blessing of Jacob (Israel) with material abundance and prosperity. Isaac's blessing explicitly invokes divine provision: 'And God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine' (Genesis 27:28-29). The text further shows Yahweh granting Jacob dominion over nations and his brothers, emphasizing divine favor toward Jacob who becomes the progenitor of Israel/the Hebrew people. The blessings of abundance, sustenance, and dominion align with a divine intention for the well-being and prosperity of the people.
